title: The box law at every power of two
claim: Pre-registered 2026-11-10, before the proof attempt. Doubled coordinates of FULL-REACH-PROOF-20261108-001A: contacts are the points (X, Y) with X + Y odd; an h (X odd) reads (X +- 1, Y +- 1) with equal signs, a v (X even) reads (X +- 1, Y -+ 1); reads leaving the region die; A[c, d] = 1 when c reads d, over GF(2). The box is [0, N]^2, N = 2n - 2; the quadrant is [0, oo)^2; the half-strips are [0, N] x [0, oo) and [0, oo) x [0, N]. The corner contact is c = (0, 1), and r(w) = sum_k A^k[c, c] w^k its return series. C(z) = sum_j z^(2^j - 1) is the Catalan series mod 2 and L(z) = z + z^2 + z^4 + ... + z^n the trace polynomial of GF(2n). Target C1: at every n = 2^m >= 4, r(w) = 1/(1 + L(w^4)) in the box over GF(2); equivalently the corner returns at time 4j exactly when j + 1 is a power of two modulo 2n - 1, or r(w) = C_m(w^4)/(1 + w^(4(2n - 1))) with C_m(z) = 1 + z + z^3 + ... + z^(n - 1) the quadrant's series truncated: the quadrant's Catalan series folded modulo 2n - 1. On the way, C2: the doubling relation 1/r_2n(w) = 1/r_n(w^2) + w^4 for n = 2^m >= 4, which with r_4 gives C1 (computed: it fails from 2 to 4, 3 to 6, 5 to 10 and 6 to 12); C3: at every side n >= 3 the box's first-return series is the quadrant's plus w^(8n) plus higher terms, so the box and the quadrant agree below time 8n and differ at 8n. Found before registration (computed): C1 at 4 to 128 (REACH-HALVES-20261110-001A and its stress test); C3 at every side from 3 to 21; at n = 2 the law fails (the box is one 4-cycle, r = 1/(1 + w^4)); the corner's whole vector returns, e_c A^(4(2n - 1)) = e_c, at 4 and 8, but at 16 and 32 only at 8(2n - 1); the four-corner formula sum_i G_(c, rho^i c) rho^i = C_m(w^4)/(1 + w^(2n - 1) rho) + w^(2n - 3) rho^3 (rho the quarter turn) below w^1200 at 4, 8, 16 and 32, false at 6 and 12.
failure_conditions: A power of two n >= 4 at which the box's corner return series is not 1/(1 + L(w^4)) (computed false at 4 to 128).
A power of two n >= 4 at which 1/r_2n(w) != 1/r_n(w^2) + w^4 (computed false from 4 to 128).
remaining_obligations: C1 by proof for every m >= 2, or the lemma that would finish it, checked exactly at sides 4 to 64
C2 and C3 by proof or as computed laws with their stress test one size past
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38), its walk over GF(2), and the same walk with one or both far walls removed. Returns are a contact-level reading, so they do not depend on how the rings are declared beyond which contacts each ring holds (A45).
